# Help and feedback

- [Player guide](https://github.com/rthidfrev/Roadworks/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): controls, layers and presets.
- [Report a bug](https://github.com/rthidfrev/Roadworks/issues/new?template=01-bug-report.yml): something is not working as expected.
- [Suggest an idea](https://github.com/rthidfrev/Roadworks/issues/new?template=02-feature-request.yml): a new feature or an improvement.

Check [existing reports and ideas](https://github.com/rthidfrev/Roadworks/issues?q=is%3Aissue) before opening an issue.
Sign in to GitHub to submit a report or idea. Screenshots and logs are optional.
